name: al-agentic-dev
description: Agentic AL/Business Central development: composable skills (al-steer, al-grill-adr, al-design, al-scope, al-refine, al-implement, al-refactor, al-mutate, al-second-opinion, al-research) with two persistent layers: repo-root memory (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, .out-of-scope/) and branch-scoped feature state (architecture.html + tasks.html). Replaces complex multi-agent workflows with focused single-purpose skills, standard BC vocabulary, and KISS/YAGNI principles. BREAKING in 0.14.0: architecture and tasks shift from markdown to self-contained HTML (Mermaid + Google Fonts via CDN), driven by a data-attribute contract (data-task, data-status, data-alert, data-section, data-summary-row, data-graph) and aesthetic discipline in references/html-spec-discipline.md. ADRs and CONTEXT.md stay markdown. Legacy markdown specs are frozen; new skills refuse to operate on them. No bilingual dispatch.
